'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Alright, so here's the deal. Here's the note I was talking about, bring it to the doc lady. Nothing criminal in there, just a few lines about our business. But here's the pain in the ass: if she knows that the note is from me, she'll just tear it up on the spot. Try to gain her favor first, earn some trust, and only then pass the note over. And don't lose it, I'm not writing another one.}}

==Objectives==
* Reach Loyalty Level 3 with [[Therapist]]

==Rewards==
* +15,800 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 32,000 Roubles
** 33,600 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 36,800 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Altyn bulletproof helmet (Olive Drab)]]
{{quote|Seems like it went without a hitch, thanks.}}
